name: Advisor
summary: Let your main model ask a stronger model for advice at key moments.
what: With the advisor on, the model doing the work can consult a second, usually stronger model before choosing an approach, after repeated errors or before calling a task done. The advisor sees the whole conversation. It is experimental.

impact.title: Better decisions for less
impact.detail: A cheaper main model gets strong guidance only where it matters.

impact.title: Cheaper than always using the big model
impact.detail: The stronger model is called only now and then.

impact.title: No cache penalty
impact.detail: Turning it on or off doesn't reset the prompt cache.

howItWorks: Run /advisor and pick a model, such as /advisor opus; /advisor off turns it off.
Or start with claude --advisor <model>, or set advisorModel in settings.
Claude decides when to consult it; you can also ask for a consultation.
The advisor must be at least as capable as the main model.
Works on the Anthropic API, not on Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform or Foundry.

events.note: First changelog mention of the experimental advisor tool.
